There's this woman at my workplace—I met her when she first started working with us.
One day, she told me her phone had spoiled and she needed to call her husband. I gave her my phone to make the call. After the call, she said she also wanted to chat with him on [ORGANIZATION]. (I actually know her husband too—not face-to-face, but I have his number saved.)
I told her, “No problem. Whenever you're ready, just let me know and I'll hand you my phone again.”
Later, she came back and said, “Don't worry, I already borrowed one of my colleague's phones.” I said, “Okay, cool.”
But as I was about to step out, something caught my eye. I saw her texting her husband from that girl's phone. Instead of chatting as herself, she was testing his loyalty by pretending to be the other girl who lent her the phone!
The messages went something like this:
Her (pretending): Hello, I collected your number from your friend's hand.
Him: Sorry, who is this? What's your name?
Her: Haa, you don't remember? We met two days ago behind your working place.
Him: I don't remember ooo... but where can we meet so I can see your face?
As soon as I saw that, I knew she was up to something sneaky. I quickly stepped outside, added her husband's number to my [ORGANIZATION], and texted him straight up:
“Bro, don't fall for it—that message is from your wife. She's using another girl's number to chat you and test you.”
He replied: “Thank you.”
I went back inside to see what would happen next.
I don't know exactly what went down while I was out, but I later saw the husband's final message to her (still thinking it was the “other girl”):
Him: Sorry, I have a wife that I love. I can't leave her for anything. Please don't text me again, or else I'll block you.
The woman was smiling and looking so happy 😂😂 She thought her husband was loyal only to her.
Not knowing say I was the one who saved the day and helped prove his loyalty!
